question: Capella was saying “Flies, flies!”, but among the cast not currently there, we have Roswaal who is completely smitten with Echidna, and Clind who has taken love of the loli spirit to it’s greatest extent; I’m sure these two will make it work out somehow……!! …...However, I sort of think that Echidna wouldn’t just quietly let herself be turned into a fly, and I sort of think she might actually enjoy trying out the experience of being a fly.
answer: It’s true Echidna would like to try out being a fly, but she has properly considered the risk of that witch not returning her to normal afterwards, so I’m sure she wouldn’t make any rash decisions. I pretty sure she wouldn’t. Well, you should probably be ready, just in case!
